purpose: New post-first-run hypothesis; modify entry execution from next-bar market fill to limit-order conditional historical touch. Not an unbiased confirmation of original strategy.
universe: same ten USD-M symbols as RESET07 v1
only_changed_mechanism: entry execution by limit touch and expiry, NOT random 36pct sampling
limit_price: IMPLEMENTER_ASSUMPTION (owner did NOT provide level): LONG previous 120 completed 4h-bar HIGH breakout threshold; SHORT prior 120-bar LOW threshold. Not signal close and not next bar open.
limit_order_activation: Signal confirmed at close of 4h bar; limit active from immediately following 4h bar open, never before signal
limit_order_ttl: 7 calendar days = 42 consecutive 4h bars; expiry after 42nd bar without touch
fill_condition: LONG 4h LOW <= limit, SHORT 4h HIGH >= limit, after activation; assumed fill at exact limit upon touch; 4h OHLC cannot establish queue execution
same_candle_ambiguity: If touched limit and would hit stop on same 4h bar, assume pessimistic STOP-first after assumed fill; record ambiguous marker
costs: retain original 4bps commission and 2bps adverse slippage per side: entry effective fill at +/-2bps from limit in accounting, which is a price impact cost model not a literal maker-limit execution price
budget: Max 6 filled open tickets / 10pct equity reserved stop risk; check upon fill; pending orders do not reserve capital; one pending limit or live position per symbol
gap: No fabrication in data gaps; no fill if no observed 4h bar; pending expires at exact TTL; force liquidation on delisting unresolved
other_parameters: unchanged from RESET07 frozen v1 (including existing conservative bar-runner and kill-touch statistical convention); fidelity deviations are independently disclosed
fill_rate_denominator: placed eligible limit orders excluding pre-signal filter skips; budget skip upon touch counted as not filled, separately audited
owner_archive_rate: 36pct reference is NOT a verified limit fill statistic; counts closed outcomes rather than confirmed fills
